title: Rex Financial亚洲主管：AI交易太拥挤，期权收益策略成新宠？
speaker: Head of Asia at Rex Financial

segments.en: It's interesting, your quote here. You said everyone's nervous about volatility, so we started the conversation. But are you really going to sit out AI? Because once you do, that's, frankly, there is not much else worth owning, right?
segments.zh: 你这里的引述很有意思。你说大家都对波动感到紧张，所以我们开始了对话。但你真的要错过AI吗？因为一旦错过，坦率地说，没有太多其他值得持有的了，对吧？

segments.en: It's true. So people think about it will be the over-trillion dollar investment for the next couple of years. And then if you do not want to define a supply chain and suppliers of the supply chains, and benefit sure of the AI trade, nothing may be left at all.
segments.zh: 没错。人们认为未来几年这将是超过万亿美元的投入。如果你不想定义供应链和供应链供应商，并从AI交易中受益，那可能什么都不剩了。

segments.en: Like you're the, so you are probably excluding all maybe 80, 90% of the investment right now. Then it means that you have to sit in the AI somehow, then there will be the remaining question will be, how?
segments.zh: 你可能排除了现在80%到90%的配置。这意味着你必须以某种方式参与AI，剩下的问题就是：怎么参与？

segments.en: Like you want to go to the cash equity, our light, or the leverage if you're very confident about certain specific trading, or the, another opportunity is the collecting the income out of the option market,
segments.zh: 比如你想直接持有权益资产，或者如果你对某些特定交易非常有信心就用杠杆，或者另一个机会是从期权市场获取收益，

segments.en: because it becomes much more rich, not only for retail participation, but at the same time, the management section and the government later, they're trying to bolster or boosting the entire ecosystem of option market right now.
segments.zh: 因为期权市场变得更加丰富，不仅散户参与度提高，同时管理层和政府也在试图提振整个期权市场生态。
